headline: El Poli / MEII ESTUDIO
context: In La Unión, the municipal sports centre is much more than a sports facility. Known by everyone as El Poli, it is one of the town's main meeting places—a space where sport, leisure and everyday social life come together, welcoming people of all ages on a daily basis.
